article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Democratic Republic of the Congo: Urgent funding and enhanced response measures required
article.articleSummary: As of June 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has escalated, with 1,155 confirmed cases and 304 deaths, resulting in a case fatality rate of 26.3%. The outbreak is primarily concentrated in Ituri province, which reported 37 new cases and 13 new deaths in the last 24 hours. The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared this situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to the rapid spread of the Bundibugyo strain, which currently lacks a licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The outbreak has also impacted Uganda, with 20 confirmed cases, and poses a significant risk of further spread to South Sudan. Funding needs for the Ebola response have surged to $1.4 billion, yet only 13% of pledged funds have been disbursed, threatening containment efforts. President Tshisekedi has announced a comprehensive response plan, including enhanced security and health measures, a 21-day observation period for contacts, and accelerated construction of treatment centers.

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in India: Intensified health measures amid rising cases and outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of June 25, 2026, India is facing a significant increase in malaria cases, particularly during the monsoon season, which has strained health resources. Kerala has reported over 10,000 daily hospital visits for fever, with 27 confirmed malaria cases and 1,630 dengue cases leading to 7 fatalities this month. A tragic incident in East Singhbhum, Jharkhand, involved two students dying from cerebral malaria within 24 hours, prompting health authorities to seal a local clinic and initiate widespread screening. In Indore, 8 malaria cases were reported in April 2026, a stark contrast to the previous year. Odisha's Dhobalingi village has recorded 11 positive malaria cases, leading to urgent health campaigns. Meanwhile, Delhi has seen a decrease in malaria cases, with 42 reported from January to mid-June 2026, down from 70 in the same period last year. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi is actively conducting house visits to combat vector-borne diseases, although challenges remain in tracing sources due to incomplete addresses.

article.articleSummary: As of June 25, 2026, Kerala is grappling with a severe dengue health crisis, reporting over 10,000 daily hospital visits for fever and 1,630 confirmed dengue cases in June alone, including 601 new cases in the past week, leading to 7 deaths. Year-to-date, the state has recorded 15,882 cases and 35 fatalities, showing some improvement compared to the same period in 2024. In contrast, Delhi has reported 162 dengue cases from January 1 to mid-June 2026, a decrease from 196 cases during the same timeframe last year. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has conducted extensive surveillance, visiting over 1.7 crore households and issuing thousands of notices for mosquito breeding sites. Meanwhile, Shivli village in Maval taluka, Pune district, has confirmed 18 dengue cases amid a broader outbreak, prompting health authorities to initiate house-to-house surveys and vector-control measures. Residents are urged to avoid water storage and participate in health drives as officials work to manage the situation.

article.articleHeadline: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Infection in Brazil: Vaccination efforts crucial amid high hospitalization rates
article.articleSummary: As of June 2026, Brazil is experiencing a significant impact from Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), which has overtaken COVID-19 as the leading cause of hospital admissions for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG). Recent data indicates 343 hospitalizations among children aged 2-4 years, with 24 deaths attributed to respiratory viruses, including four directly from RSV. The country reported 97,813 SARI cases in 2026, with RSV responsible for 53.1% of lab-confirmed cases. Vaccination coverage is alarmingly low at 52.91%, prompting health authorities to stress the importance of vaccinations, particularly during the winter months. The RSV vaccine is now part of the National Immunization Program for pregnant women, while influenza vaccines are being administered to vulnerable groups. SARI activity remains high across most regions, with notable increases in cases driven by RSV, particularly in the South and Southeast. Enhanced preventive measures and surveillance are urgently needed to combat the ongoing respiratory illness crisis.

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in Indonesia: Community engagement drives innovative prevention strategies
article.articleSummary: Malaria poses a significant health challenge in Indonesia, with Tanjungpinang City reporting 518 cases from January to June 2026. Health authorities are enhancing surveillance and educating residents on the importance of prompt treatment and adherence to a 14-day medication regimen. Preventive measures include environmental hygiene and targeted vector control, focusing on 58 swampy sites and conducting two fogging cycles to reduce adult mosquito populations. Areas like Sebauk Darat and Kampung Bebek show declining trends, while Sebauk Laut and Senggarang Besar continue to experience high transmission rates. In Nabire Regency, an outbreak affected 124 residents, prompting a coordinated response from local authorities, who established an emergency health post and provided treatment and resources. In Jayapura City, malaria cases remain high, with 68,785 confirmed cases in 2025. The local government is intensifying prevention efforts through strengthened coordination among community units and volunteers, aiming for malaria elimination by 2027.

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 in China: Monitoring trends amid low overall case counts
article.articleSummary: Mainland China's COVID-19 positivity rate has increased for three consecutive weeks, currently at 5.1% for outpatient and emergency department visits. Year-to-date, monthly case counts have fluctuated between 17,000 and 26,000, with a cumulative total of 109,019 cases and 9 deaths reported by May, significantly lower than last year's totals of 761,239 cases and 28 deaths. Authorities emphasize the need for ongoing monitoring due to last summer's peak, while Taiwan's CDC reports low outpatient visits with no significant rebound. Globally, COVID-19 positivity is rising in various regions, highlighting the importance of vigilance in managing transmission, especially in indoor and poorly ventilated spaces.

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in Brazil: Legal issues complicate health crisis response
article.articleSummary: As of June 25, 2026, Brazilian rapper Oruam is critically ill with pulmonary tuberculosis, showing severe symptoms including lung lesions, chronic cough, and significant weight loss of about 5 kg in the past month. He has been a fugitive for over 130 days, facing attempted homicide charges against police officers. His defense team sought to have him released from preventive detention due to his deteriorating health, but a judge denied this request, stating that a medical evaluation would only occur upon his return to custody. The case highlights the intersection of serious health issues and legal challenges in Brazil, with no new outbreaks or laboratory confirmations reported. Oruam's situation raises concerns about the adequacy of health care within the prison system and the implications for individuals facing legal issues while suffering from serious health conditions.

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in India: Mizoram faces critical challenges in TB management
article.articleSummary: In the first half of 2026, Mizoram reported 1,087 new tuberculosis cases and 71 deaths, according to the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP). Out of 61,246 individuals tested, 93.5% of confirmed cases were in individuals aged 14 and above, with 600 males and 68 children under 14 affected. The report highlighted 47 cases of multidrug-resistant TB (MDR-TB) and 520 cases of pulmonary TB. Additionally, 92 patients were co-infected with HIV. The treatment success rate was recorded at 86.49%, but only 28% of patients received nutritional support through the Nikshay Mitra Initiative, which provided food baskets to 374 patients. Authorities stress the importance of increased community participation and donor support to improve TB management efforts. Ongoing initiatives are focused on awareness campaigns, early diagnosis, and timely treatment to alleviate the TB burden in the region.

triage.notes: 複数地域での同時発生：北キブ県ワリカレ地域（4月以降19確診例、3死亡）とクワンゴ県ポポカバカ保健地区（5月24日以降136報告例、10死亡）。両地域で医療資源の深刻な不足が報告され、人道支援が緊急に必要とされている。コレラの地域流行の継続を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Brazil: Municipal strategies show mixed results across regions
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Sorocaba have dramatically decreased to 62 confirmed cases from January 1 to May 28, 2026, with no fatalities, representing a more than 99% reduction compared to 2025's 13,151 cases and 22 deaths. This success is attributed to effective municipal strategies focusing on prevention and vector control, including breeding-site elimination and home inspections. Conversely, Barretos reported 230 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,965 notifications from January 1 to June 25, 2026, with two hospitalizations but no deaths, indicating ongoing transmission and the need for vigilance. Meanwhile, Campinas has issued a dengue alert for 30 high-risk neighborhoods, recording 3,193 cases from January 1 to June 18, 2026. The city has conducted extensive property inspections and fogging efforts, targeting areas with high breeding site densities. Residents are urged to eliminate standing water and report potential breeding sites to local authorities, as approximately 80% of breeding sites are found within homes.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのデング熱：地域によって異なる結果を示す市レベルの戦略
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのデング熱の複数地域での発生が報告されており、スクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」と「長期曝露」に該当する可能性があるが、死亡者が少ないことと対策の有効性が示されているため、現段階では情報収集継続が適切。
triage.notes: Sorocaba地域では対策により99%の症例減少を達成しているが、Barretos（230確認症例、2入院）とCampinas（3,193症例）では継続的な感染が記録されている。ブラジルは対象国（WPRO対象外）だが、デング熱は世界的なエンデミック疾患であり、複数都市での同時流行は経過観察を要する。死亡者数が少ないため深刻度は低いと評価。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in Democratic Republic of the Congo: Outbreak prompts urgent health response and surveillance efforts
article.articleSummary: In Kwilu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, a malaria outbreak has resulted in twelve fatalities in Bulungu territory since late May. The village of Mukulubiala has been severely impacted, causing residents to flee due to fears of an Ebola outbreak, which health officials have confirmed is unfounded. Patients have presented with common malaria symptoms, including fever, headaches, abdominal pain, and vomiting. The Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB) has verified malaria diagnoses, with further samples being analyzed in Kinshasa. This outbreak highlights the ongoing challenges of malaria in the region, where underdiagnosis and inadequate treatment are prevalent. Globally, malaria continues to pose a significant health threat, with 263 million cases and 597,000 deaths reported in 2023, primarily in Africa. The Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a high-burden country, exacerbated by factors such as climate change, conflict, and drug resistance, contributing to the overall increase in malaria cases and fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のマラリア：アウトブレイクが緊急の健康対応と監視活動を促す
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは既知の風土病であり、DRCでの死亡報告（12名）は懸念されるが、IHR基準2つ以上該当との明確な根拠は薄い。ただしスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行傾向、管理可能性）で複数該当し、情報確実性の観点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: マラリアは既知の風土病であり異常性が低いが、12名の死亡とBulunguでの局所的なアウトブレイク、気候変動や薬剤耐性といった基礎要因により継続的な懸念がある。Ebola懸念の報道も社会的関心を高めている。フルRRAには至らないが、地域のマラリア負荷追跡と介入有効性の経過観察が重要。

locations.name: Parassala, State of Tamil Nadu, India

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in India: Community awareness crucial for effective prevention efforts
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, dengue remains a significant health concern in India, particularly during the monsoon season. The World Health Organization has identified India as one of the countries most impacted by the global rise in dengue cases. With no specific antiviral treatment available, prevention and timely medical care are essential. Misconceptions about cleanliness contribute to the spread, as mosquitoes can breed in clean environments with standing water, such as in plant trays and blocked drains. This risk extends to public spaces, necessitating increased community vigilance. Early symptoms of dengue, including high fever and body aches, can mimic other viral illnesses, making awareness critical. Severe cases require urgent medical attention for warning signs like persistent vomiting. Effective management includes hydration and close monitoring. In a related incident, Kerala MLA C.K. Hareendran, who was treated for dengue, attended the Legislative Assembly despite his illness, highlighting the challenges faced by public officials during health crises.

triage.headline_ja: インドのデング熱：効果的な予防のためにはコミュニティの認識が重要
triage.triage_reason: インドでのデング熱の継続的な懸念は報告されているが、具体的な発生数、死亡数、または新規クラスターに関する詳細情報が不足しており、現在進行中の流行の規模を判断できない。コミュニティ啓発に焦点を当てた記事であり、IHR基準を明確に満たす証拠が不十分。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の予防と認識に関する一般的なガイダンスを提供しており、具体的な発生数、死亡、または医療逼迫の状況は記載されていない。KERALAとTAMIL NADUが言及されているが、これらは背景情報であり、特定のアウトブレイク・クラスターの証拠は限定的。WHO言及あり。続報で具体的な症例数・死亡数データが得られれば、ピックアップ候補となる可能性あり。

locations.name: Tan Phu, Tinh Vinh Long, Vietnam

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever in Vietnam: Crackdown on illegal trade and rising outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Vietnam is facing a critical situation with African swine fever (ASF) as significant outbreaks have been reported, particularly in Dong Nai City, where 40 outbreaks have led to the culling of over 13,500 pigs by June 12, 2026. The region's large-scale farms are at heightened risk due to their proximity to infected areas. In Thanh Hoa province, authorities have intensified legal actions against the illegal trade of ASF-infected pigs, prosecuting individuals involved in the buying and selling of infected livestock. Recent investigations uncovered a network of brokers facilitating these transactions, resulting in the seizure of dozens of infected pigs. The situation is exacerbated by environmental factors such as open housing and the rainy season, which contribute to disease transmission. With no effective vaccine available, authorities are ramping up disinfection efforts, surveillance, and public awareness campaigns to mitigate the spread of ASF.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのアフリカンスワインフィーバー：違法取引の取り締まりと発生の増加
triage.triage_reason: アフリカンスワインフィーバーはOIEが監視する重要な動物疾病であり、大規模な発生とヒト媒介による拡散リスクが指摘されている。しかし、家畜疾病であり公衆衛生への直接的な影響は不明であり、IHR基準の満たし方が明確でないため、情報の確認と続報を要す。
triage.notes: アフリカンスワインフィーバーは家畜疾病であり、IHR(2005)の直接適用対象ではない。ただしベトナムで大規模発生（6月12日時点で40件の発生、13,500頭以上の豚が殺処分）、違法な感染豚の取引ネットワークが摘発されている。環境要因（開放型飼舎、雨季）と管理不十分が拡散を助長している。WPRO基準では重症度、長期曝露、流行性、管理可能性で該当。OIEレベルでは重要だが、公衆衛生IHRの観点から継続監視が必要。豚肉や豚製品の国際取引への影響可能性。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza B in Brazil: High incidence of respiratory illnesses reported nationwide
article.articleSummary: Brazil is currently experiencing a significant increase in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARI) cases, with a notable 7.9% rise in influenza B cases reported. The latest data indicates that eight states, including Alagoas, Amapá, and Rio de Janeiro, have sustained increases in SARI cases for six weeks. The period from June 14 to June 20 showed high-risk incidence across most of the country, with the South and Southeast regions particularly affected. Other respiratory viruses, such as Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), have also surged, with a 53.1% increase noted. Hospitalizations due to influenza A and B are rising, especially in Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul, and Paraná. Despite the increase in respiratory illnesses, COVID-19 cases remain low. Vaccination efforts are emphasized as the best protection against these respiratory infections, as nearly 98,000 SARI hospitalizations have been recorded this year, with a significant number awaiting confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのインフルエンザB：呼吸器疾患の高い発生率が全国で報告
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザB感染の著しい増加（7.9%上昇）、広範な地理的拡大（8州で6週間持続的増加）、入院の増加が報告されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 複数地域での6週間持続的な増加、入院数の増加（約98,000件SARI入院、確認待ち多数）、複数の呼吸器ウイルス同時流行（RSV 53.1%増加）により、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がある。情報源は公式の保健省系報道機関（Agência Brasil）。

article.articleHeadline: Measles in Brazil: Vaccination campaigns intensify amid regional outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Brazil is on high alert for measles as the risk of reintroduction looms due to increased travel ahead of the World Cup 2026. In 2025, the Federal District reported 71 suspected cases, with one confirmed imported case and no secondary transmission. As of 2026, there have been 20 suspected cases, none confirmed. The majority of confirmed cases in 2025 involved unvaccinated individuals, underscoring the critical need for vaccination. The recommended vaccination schedule includes two doses of the MMR vaccine for children aged 1-29 and one dose for adults aged 30-59. The Health Department (SES-DF) emphasizes public awareness of measles symptoms, such as fever and rash, and encourages vaccination at over 170 health units. Brazil has been certified measles-free by PAHO/WHO since 2024, but the ongoing outbreaks in neighboring countries necessitate continued vigilance. Nationally, over 248,000 measles cases have been reported worldwide this year, with significant numbers in Canada, Mexico, and the United States, highlighting the importance of maintaining high vaccination coverage.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおける麻疹：地域的な流行の中、予防接種キャンペーンが強化される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは麻疹認定排除国だが、隣国での流行と2026年ワールドカップ前の渡航増加に伴う再導入リスクが指摘されている。現在の確認症例は限定的（2026年は確認症例なし）だが、地域的な流行動向と国際的な関心が存在するため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルはPAHO/WHOにより2024年以来麻疹排除認定を受けているが、隣国での流行と2026年ワールドカップ前の国際的な移動増加により再導入リスクが高まっている。現在のところ確認症例は限定的だが、ワクチン接種率維持と監視継続が重要。IHR基準は2つ該当し、WPRO基準は3つ該当するが、確認症例の重症度が低く、対象国内での流行は進行していない点からWATCH判定とした。

locations.name: Kabupaten Nagekeo, Provinsi Nusa Tenggara Timur, Indonesia

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Indonesia: Urgent action required to manage dog bites
article.articleSummary: In Nagekeo Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, dog bite cases have surged to approximately 2,000 from January to May 2026, with four out of five tested samples confirming rabies. Tragically, one resident died from rabies after neglecting to report the bite and missing vaccination. The region has experienced a year-over-year increase in reported bites since 2023. Currently, health officials have about 1,000 vials of Rabies Vaccine (VAR) available, but they warn that this stock is insufficient without effective dog-control measures. Community health centers are assessing local vaccine needs, but the high dog population in Boawae district is linked to a significant incidence of bites. Authorities express concern that the actual number of bites may be underreported, emphasizing the urgent need for comprehensive strategies to manage both the dog population and vaccination efforts to prevent further rabies cases.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの狂犬病：犬咬傷の管理に向けた緊急対応が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準でも複数項目該当。死亡例が報告され、ワクチン不足と未報告ケースの懸念から管理可能性に課題あり。
triage.notes: 5ヶ月間で約2,000件の犬咬傷事例、うち4/5検体が狂犬病陽性、死亡例1件。ワクチン在庫1,000バイアルは不足予測。2023年以降の年間増加傾向と未報告ケースの懸念から、地域的な感染制御体制の強化が必要。

locations.name: National Capital Territory of Delhi, India

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in India: Weather changes influence viral infection patterns
article.articleSummary: As of April 2026, Indore has reported a notable increase in chikungunya cases alongside dengue and malaria due to weather changes, with 25 dengue and 8 malaria cases recorded. Health authorities are actively managing the situation by ensuring the availability of medicines and conducting extensive surveys to identify mosquito larvae in residential areas. In Delhi, from January to mid-June 2026, there have been 9 chikungunya cases, alongside 162 dengue and 42 malaria cases, indicating a decrease compared to the previous year. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has conducted over 830,000 house visits, identifying mosquito larvae in over 4,000 homes and issuing thousands of notices to combat the spread of these vector-borne diseases. The upcoming monsoon months are expected to further influence disease patterns, with heightened vigilance in areas prone to outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: インドのチクングニア熱：気象変動がウイルス感染パターンに影響

triage.notes: チクングニア熱はインドで季節性の蚊媒介感染症として報告されている。記事はインドール（マディヤプラデーシュ州）とデリーでの患者報告を述べており、天候変動と流行パターンの関連が指摘されている。現時点での症例数は比較的少なく、国内対策が実施されている。今後の雨季による流行拡大の可能性があるため、継続的な情報収集が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Melioidosis in Thailand: Imported cases highlight ongoing health risks
article.articleSummary: As of June 25, 2026, Primorsky Krai, Russia, has confirmed an imported case of melioidosis involving a female tourist who recently returned from Thailand. The patient is hospitalized in serious condition at Krai Clinical Hospital No. 2. Health authorities have stated that there is no risk of community spread, as the infection is attributed to exposure in Thailand, where melioidosis is endemic due to the presence of Burkholderia pseudomallei in soil and water. Preventive measures and monitoring of contacts are being implemented to ensure no secondary transmission occurs. The case underscores the health risks associated with travel to regions where melioidosis is prevalent, although no local outbreaks have been reported.

triage.headline_ja: タイにおけるメリオイドーシス：輸入症例が継続的な健康リスクを浮き彫りに
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスはタイで風土病であり、輸入症例は単一事例（ロシアの観光客）。地域社会での感染拡大リスクがなく、国際的拡大リスクも低い。
triage.notes: 記事はタイでのメリオイドーシス風土病を背景とした輸入症例（ロシア観光客）を報告しているが、タイでの新規流行やアウトブレイクは記載されていない。タイにおける実質的な感染症イベント（新規発生や拡大）は確認できないため、シグナルの対象外と判定した。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1 in India: Recent fatalities underscore public health concerns
article.articleSummary: As of June 25, 2026, Kerala has reported four fatalities due to H1N1 this month, including a 73-year-old man and an 18-year-old girl. The recent death in Palakkad marks the district's second H1N1-related death amid a backdrop of rising seasonal illnesses. The region is also facing a significant dengue outbreak, with over 1,630 cases and more than 25 deaths reported in June. Health authorities are urging the public to seek immediate medical attention for febrile illnesses and are cautioning against self-medication. The concurrent spread of H1N1 and dengue is raising serious public health concerns, prompting officials to closely monitor the situation and implement preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: インド人獣共通感染症H1N1の人感染：最近の死亡例が公衆衛生上の懸念を浮き彫りにする
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。複数の死亡例と同時多発的なデング熱流行により、地域の保健システム圧迫が懸念される。
triage.notes: ケーラ州での2026年6月単月での4死亡例（73歳男性、18歳女性を含む）、パラッカド地区での第2例目の死亡を報告。同時にデング熱1,630例以上・25死以上が発生中。複数の蚊媒介感染症の同時流行により、地域保健当局の対応能力や医療リソースへの圧迫が懸念される。記事は公式保健当局の公式コメントに基づく報道。

locations.name: Kabupaten Luwu Timur, South Sulawesi, Indonesia

article.articleHeadline: Influenza in Indonesia: Climate impacts and health initiatives to combat infections
article.articleSummary: In Indonesia, recent climate shifts have significantly impacted health, particularly respiratory infections and influenza. In East Luwu, Sulawesi Selatan, the transition to the rainy season has led to an increase in pediatric pneumonia cases, rising from 46 to 55 in May 2026, alongside a slight uptick in gastroenteritis cases. Health officials attribute these trends to abrupt temperature changes that weaken immunity, heightening the risk of acute respiratory infections (ARI). Concurrently, the OKU Regency Health Office in South Sumatra reported 19 suspected cases of Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) from January to June 2026, urging residents to adopt Clean and Healthy Living (PHBS) practices to mitigate the spread of infections, including influenza. The dry season's indoor activities are linked to increased transmission risks, prompting health authorities to enhance educational campaigns on nutrition, exercise, and hygiene practices to protect vulnerable populations, especially children.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのインフルエンザ：気候変動の影響と感染症対策の取り組み
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのインフルエンザ関連の呼吸器感染症増加が報告されており、小児肺炎症例の増加（46→55件）が確認されている。ただし、IHR基準の該当数が不明確で、死亡報告や国際的な拡大リスクについての情報が不足しており、PICKUP判定に至らない段階。継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシア（南スラウェシ州、南スマトラ州）での気候季節変動に伴う呼吸器感染症増加を報告。小児肺炎、HFMD、ARIが主な懸念事項。ただし死亡例や重症例の具体的報告がなく、重症度評価が困難。気候要因による季節的な増加パターンであり、通常の範囲内の可能性がある。社会的関心と政府の対応活動は確認されるが、国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: HIV in Ghana: Urgent need for targeted interventions and support
article.articleSummary: Ghana's 2024 HIV statistics reveal a critical public health crisis, with 15,290 new infections and 12,614 AIDS-related deaths reported among 334,721 individuals living with HIV. Young females aged 15-24 are disproportionately affected, accounting for over 80% of new infections in that demographic. Women represent 68.5% of the total population living with HIV, with significant numbers of new infections and AIDS deaths occurring among them. Despite achieving a 99.3% success rate in preventing mother-to-child transmission, the country struggles to meet the global 95-95-95 targets, with only 68% of those living with HIV aware of their status and less than half of adults receiving treatment. The need for intensified prevention education, stigma reduction, and improved access to antiretroviral therapy is urgent. Additionally, addressing socio-economic factors and mobilizing support from government and civil society are essential for effective intervention and to mitigate the impact of HIV on national productivity and healthcare.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナのHIV：標的を絞った介入と支援の緊急の必要性
triage.triage_reason: ガーナで15,290件の新規HIV感染と12,614件のエイズ関連死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響）とWPRO基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）の複数に該当する。国の対応能力が限定的であることが示唆されており、シグナルとしてフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: ガーナは対象国リストに含まれていないが、同国での重大なHIV危機が報告されており、WPRO基準で複数項目該当するため PICKUP 判定。若い女性（15-24歳）が新規感染の80%以上を占めており、特定のハイリスク集団への対応が急務である。治療へのアクセスが限定的（成人の50%未満）であり、国家対応能力の強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis in India: Current trends and public health responses
article.articleSummary: As of June 23, 2026, Kerala has reported 1,531 cases of leptospirosis, resulting in 56 deaths, marking a decline from 1,962 cases and 122 deaths in 2024. This trend reflects broader improvements in communicable diseases, with dengue cases at 15,882 and 35 deaths, significantly lower than the 2017 peak. Hepatitis A cases have also decreased to 9,436 with 36 deaths. Health Minister K Muraleedharan noted that most communicable diseases are below historical peaks, except for a notable increase in Shigella cases. Leptospirosis, endemic across all districts, has a mortality rate averaging 6%, with complications affecting multiple organs. Despite the availability of doxycycline, fatalities persist due to delays in diagnosis and treatment. A top committee has recommended protective measures for workers in contaminated areas and emphasized the need for hotspot mapping and data transparency. Recent statistics show a consistent incidence of cases and deaths over the past few years, indicating ongoing public health challenges.

triage.headline_ja: インドのレプトスピラ症：現在の傾向と公衆衛生対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・重症性）し、地域スクリーニング基準でも重症度・長期曝露・管理可能性で懸念あり。ケーラ州での継続的発生（1,531症例、死亡56人）と診断遅延による死亡は公衆衛生上のシグナルである。
triage.notes: ケーラ州ではレプトスピラ症が全地域に遍在し、診断遅延による致命率6%が継続的な課題。記事サマリーで触れられている保護措置の推奨やホットスポット特定の必要性は、地域の対応能力不足を示唆している。2024年からの症例減少傾向にもかかわらず、絶対数として相応の患者発生が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Syphilis in China: Awareness needed for atypical symptoms and transmission
article.articleSummary: On June 24, 2026, a notable case of secondary syphilis was reported in Foshan, China, involving a 19-year-old male who exhibited severe patchy hair loss resembling insect bites. Serological tests confirmed the diagnosis with a TPPA positive result and an RPR titer of 1:128. This case highlights a rare mucocutaneous manifestation of syphilis, where the Treponema pallidum bacterium affects hair follicles, leading to inflammatory responses and hair shedding. The report underscores the importance of recognizing syphilis as a potential cause of unusual symptoms, particularly in individuals engaging in high-risk sexual behavior. While the case did not indicate any outbreaks or imported cases, it emphasizes the need for increased awareness, safe sex practices, and routine screening for high-risk populations to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の梅毒：非典型的症状と伝播への認識の必要性
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは示唆されていない。疾患管理の啓発記事として位置づけられ、シグナル要件を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は佛山市で報告された19歳男性の二次梅毒単一症例に関するもの。発症機構の啓発を主目的とし、アウトブレイクや流行の拡大は言及されていない。梅毒は周知の疾患であり、既存の伝播リスク対策の範囲内と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis in Philippines: Increased cases linked to rainy season exposure
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in the Philippines increased by 6% in early 2026, with 2,177 reported cases from January 1 to June 6, compared to 2,046 during the same period in 2025. The Department of Health highlights that most cases involve farmers and individuals frequently exposed to floodwaters during the rainy season. This bacterial infection, primarily transmitted through contact with contaminated soil and water, poses significant health risks. Symptoms include fever, muscle pain, headache, and jaundice, among others. Preventive measures emphasize avoiding wading in floodwaters and using protective gear. The current statistics underscore the importance of ongoing surveillance and public health awareness as the rainy season progresses.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンのレプトスピラ症：雨季の曝露に関連した患者数増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で異常性と国際的拡大リスク、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度・流行しやすさが該当。前年比6%増加の持続的な患者報告と雨季による継続的な曝露リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: フィリピン保健省による積極的な監視と公開情報発表あり。雨季中の継続的な曝露により患者数増加傾向が続く可能性。農業従事者と洪水被害者が主要なリスク集団として特定されている。

article.articleHeadline: E. coli in India: Contaminated water raises health concerns in Indore
article.articleSummary: E. coli contamination has been confirmed in the water supply from Indore's Khatiwala Tank, sourced from the Narmada river. Residents have reported health issues including fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain after consuming the water, which has been allegedly contaminated for the past four months. A private laboratory test conducted by a local doctor verified that the water is unsafe for drinking. Despite the alarming situation, no deaths have been reported, and there have been no described remediation efforts to address the contamination. This incident underscores a critical public health issue regarding drinking water safety in Indore, emphasizing the urgent need for water-quality monitoring and protective measures to ensure the health of the community.

triage.headline_ja: インド：大腸菌汚染、インドールの飲料水供給に健康上の懸念
triage.triage_reason: 水道水汚染による集団発症、多数の住民に健康被害が報告されており、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」と「異常・予想外な事象」に該当。WPROスクリーニングでは重症度、長期曝露、管理可能性で複数基準を満たす。
triage.notes: インドール市のKhatiwala Tank水源からの大腸菌汚染が確認。4ヶ月間にわたる汚染で、発熱、嘔吐、下痢、腹痛などの症状が多数報告されている。死亡例なし。私有ラボでの検査で不安全であることが確認された。飲料水安全対策の急務を示唆する公衆衛生上の重要な案件。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Vietnam: Intensified control measures amid ongoing outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Two dengue fever outbreaks are currently affecting Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, with significant activity in Vũng Áng Ward's Hop Tien neighborhood and Hoành Sơn Ward's Liên Phú neighborhood. The outbreaks began on April 3 and May 3, respectively, leading to a total of 119 reported cases, including 97 in Vũng Áng and 22 in Hoành Sơn. As of now, 96 patients have recovered, while 23 remain under treatment. Health authorities are ramping up control measures, focusing on surveillance, environmental sanitation, and the elimination of mosquito breeding sites. Despite initial vector control efforts, community participation has been inconsistent, particularly in managing water-holding containers, which are crucial for mosquito breeding. Authorities are urging residents to enhance cooperation, especially following rainfall, to effectively combat the spread of dengue.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのデング熱：流行中の発生に対して制御措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで複数地域にわたるデング熱アウトブレイク（119例、死亡例なし）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当。対象国での確認事例であるため、フルRRA進行の対象とする。
triage.notes: ベトナムのハティン省で2件の同時アウトブレイク（4月3日開始、5月3日開始）が報告されている。119例のうち96例が回復、23例が治療中。死亡例の報告なし。蚊媒介感染症のため季節性あり。地域当局が積極的な制御措置を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Cholera in India: Contaminated water sources fuel health crises
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, significant drinking-water contamination has been reported, affecting 351 sites across 21 rivers, with aging wells contributing to the pollution. This situation has led to an increase in waterborne diseases, including cholera, typhoid, and hepatitis A, particularly in Kottayam, where health indicators are deteriorating. Since 2021, the region has seen a notable rise in these diseases due to the consumption of contaminated water. As of 2026, Kerala has reported 387 malaria cases, primarily among migrant workers and returning residents, highlighting the challenges posed by insufficient tracking of incoming populations. Previous outbreaks of cholera and other waterborne diseases were more concentrated in states like Odisha, Jharkhand, and Bihar, but the current situation in Kerala underscores the urgent need for improved sanitation and monitoring to prevent further health crises.

triage.headline_ja: インドのコレラ：汚染された水源が健康危機を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: コレラを含む水系感染症がインドのケーララ州で増加しており、IHR基準において異常性（予想外の地域への拡大）、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が認められ、2つ以上の基準に該当する。WPRO基準でも複数基準該当し、社会的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年の日付であり、ケーララ州のコッタヤム地域を中心にコレラを含む水系感染症が増加していることを報告。351の飲料水汚染地点、複数州（ケーララ、オディシャ、ジャールカンド、ビハール）での流行が記述されており、従来の流行地域（オディシャ、ビハール）に加えてケーララへの地理的拡大が顕著。下水処理不備や井戸老朽化など構造的問題が基盤にあり、帰還住民や移民労働者を含む多数の人口曝露が懸念される。国際的な公衆衛生上の関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis A in India: Contaminated water sources fuel health concerns
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) has reported alarming levels of drinking-water contamination, affecting 351 sites across 21 rivers. This situation has led to a notable increase in waterborne diseases, including hepatitis A, typhoid, and cholera, particularly in Kottayam, where health indicators are deteriorating. Since 2021, the region has seen a rise in cases linked to contaminated drinking water, with the ongoing issues exacerbated by aging wells that mix pollutants. As of 2026, Kerala has reported 387 malaria cases, primarily among migrant workers and returning residents, highlighting the challenges posed by insufficient tracking and monitoring of these populations. The resurgence of these diseases underscores the critical need for improved sanitation and water quality management in the state.

triage.headline_ja: インドのA型肝炎：汚染された水源が健康上の懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: インドのケララ州で複数の水系感染症（A型肝炎、腸チフス、コレラ）が増加しており、IHR基準で「異常・予想外」「深刻な公衆衛生影響」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当し、対象国での明確な感染症クラスター。
triage.notes: 記事はインド（特にケララ州）での水系感染症の増加を報告。2021年以降の継続的な増加傾向、複数疾患の同時発生（A型肝炎・腸チフス・コレラ）、飲料水汚染（351サイト、21河川）により、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。マラリア症例も報告されており、総合的な感染症管理能力の課題が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Typhoid in India: Contaminated water sources fuel ongoing health crisis
article.articleSummary: In Kerala, significant drinking-water contamination has been reported, with 351 sites across 21 rivers affected, leading to a rise in waterborne diseases since 2021. The Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) highlights that aging wells are mixing pollutants into the water supply, exacerbating health issues. Typhoid, along with hepatitis A and cholera, has seen increased cases, particularly in Kottayam, where health indicators are deteriorating. As of 2026, Kerala has reported 387 malaria cases, primarily among migrant workers and returning residents. The lack of effective tracking for incoming individuals from other states has contributed to the ongoing transmission of these diseases. Previous outbreaks of typhoid and other waterborne illnesses were more concentrated in states like Odisha, Jharkhand, and Bihar, but the current situation in Kerala underscores the urgent need for improved sanitation and monitoring to combat the health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: インドの腸チフス：汚染された水源が継続的な健康危機を招いている
triage.triage_reason: 腸チフスを含む水系感染症の多発がインドで報告され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響（複数州での症例増加、351の汚染サイト）と異常性（2021年以降の上昇傾向）が認識される。IHR基準2項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年という未来日付であるが、シミュレーション/シナリオ記事の可能性がある。腸チフスの継続的な伝播、複数州での被害（ケーララ州、ビハール州、オディシャ州）、飲料水汚染による水系感染症多発が報告されており、公衆衛生上の重要なシグナルと判断。CPCB（中央公害制御委員会）による公式警告の存在も政府関心の高さを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in India: Current challenges in controlling transmission and outbreaks
article.articleSummary: In 2026, Kerala reported 387 malaria cases, primarily affecting migrant workers and returning Malayalis. This increase is linked to inadequate tracking of individuals arriving from other states and poor pre-monsoon sanitation. The Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) has identified significant drinking-water contamination across 351 sites in 21 rivers, exacerbating health issues. Since 2021, there has been a notable rise in waterborne diseases, including typhoid and cholera, due to contaminated drinking water sources. Historical data shows a decline in malaria cases from around 2,000 in 2010 to approximately 268 in recent years, attributed to effective control measures. However, the current situation highlights ongoing challenges in managing malaria transmission, particularly among vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: インドのマラリア：感染伝播とアウトブレイク管理における現在の課題
triage.triage_reason: ケーラ州での387件のマラリア患者報告は地域的には重要だが、全国的な異常や国際的拡大の明確な証拠は記事から読み取れない。水道水汚染と水系感染症の増加傾向は注視すべきだが、詳細情報が不足しており、続報により判定が変わる可能性がある。
triage.notes: 2026年のケーラ州におけるマラリア患者数387件は過去数年の268件から増加。移住労働者と帰郷者が主な患者層。2021年以降、水系感染症（チフス・コレラ）の増加傾向が報告されており、飲用水汚染が根本原因。IHR基準は1つ、WPRO基準は3つ該当するが、重症度、管理可能性、国際的拡大リスクに関する具体的情報が不足しているため、現段階ではWATCH判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis in Indonesia: Health officials warn of increasing transmission risks
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in Pati Regency, Central Java, Indonesia, have sharply increased, with the Pati Health Department issuing warnings about the dangers of transmission through rat urine. The number of reported cases has escalated from 7 in 2022 to 22 in 2023, reaching 61 in 2025, and peaking at 172 cases by the end of May 2026. The disease spreads when bacteria from contaminated water or soil enter the body through open wounds, and can also be transmitted via contaminated food or drinks. The risk is particularly high during the early rainy season and among individuals working in wet environments, such as farmers and fishermen. A suspected case in Semarang was linked to a beverage can contaminated with rat urine, highlighting the ongoing transmission risk. Authorities emphasize the need for increased awareness and preventive measures during the wet season to mitigate the spread of this disease.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのレプトスピラ症：保健当局が感染伝播リスク増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア中部ジャワ州パティ県でレプトスピラ症の症例が急増（2022年7例→2025年61例→2026年5月末172例）し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常な流行パターンが認められる。スクリーニング基準で重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさに該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は中部ジャワ州パティ県での発生を主題としており、インドネシアが対象国に該当するため verified_locations に含める。短期間での急激な症例増加（月平均約34例増）と、雨季における職業的リスク層への浸透が注目される。飲用缶へのネズミ尿汚染事例は食品経由伝播の可能性を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Indonesia: El Niño exacerbates dengue transmission and risks
article.articleSummary: El Niño, expected to persist until late 2026, is significantly increasing the spread of dengue fever in Indonesia. Gadjah Mada University projects that over 2 million dengue fever patients will require treatment nationwide in 2024, with numbers anticipated to escalate as temperatures rise. The breeding habitat for Aedes aegypti mosquitoes is expanding, making dengue fever a year-round threat. In the past seven years, fatalities have been notably high, with 41% of deaths occurring among children aged 5-14. Protective measures are advised, including dressing children in long sleeves and bright colors, using mosquito repellent judiciously, and employing a 3M approach to mosquito eradication. Early recognition of symptoms is crucial, and vaccination is recommended by the Indonesian Pediatric Society as part of childhood immunization. Adults with pre-existing health conditions face increased risks, with hypertensive patients being 2-3 times more likely to experience complications, and those with diabetes up to 5 times. Community education and ongoing prevention efforts are essential as dengue remains a serious health threat in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのデング熱：エルニーニョがデング熱の伝播と危険性を悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の大規模発生が報告されており、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「公衆衛生への影響の深刻さ」に該当し、WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」に複数該当する。エルニーニョによる拡大傾向と多数の死亡例（特に小児）が報告されており、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年のデータを参照しており、年間200万人以上の患者発生予測、過去7年間で41%の死亡が5-14歳の小児で発生、高血圧患者の合併症リスク2-3倍、糖尿病患者で5倍という具体的なリスク情報が記載されている。エルニーニョとの関連性が明示され、年間を通じた蚊の繁殖地拡大が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza in Brazil: Vaccination efforts ramp up amid rising case counts
article.articleSummary: Cuiabá, Brazil, has reported a significant 153.46% increase in influenza cases in 2026 compared to the previous year, with 1,574 confirmed cases and 2,034 notifications by early June. Alarmingly, 828 of these cases are in children aged 0–6. Vaccination coverage among priority groups is critically low at 33.45%, far below the Ministry of Health's target of 95%. In response to this public health challenge, the Municipal Health Secretariat is enhancing vaccination efforts by providing home-based shots for patients with limited mobility. Seventy-two Family Health Units are involved in this initiative, allowing families to request home visits for vaccination. Clinicians assess patients' eligibility and administer the vaccine at home when appropriate. This program is part of a broader strategy to improve vaccination rates and educate caregivers, with the influenza vaccine available at all health units. Influenza remains a highly transmissible respiratory infection, posing severe risks, particularly to vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのインフルエンザ：症例数増加の中でワクチン接種の取り組みが加速
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのクイアバで153.46%の急激なインフルエンザ症例増加が報告されており、ワクチン接種率が極めて低い（33.45%）ことが懸念される。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と予想外の増加が認められ、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのクイアバ地域での具体的なインフルエンザ流行を報告している。症例増加率が高く（153.46%）、特に幼児（0-6歳）828症例を含む。ワクチン接種率が目標値95%に対して33.45%と極めて低いため、今後のさらなる拡大のリスクがある。政府による積極的な対応（家庭訪問予防接種プログラムの実施）が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in Brazil: Health authorities warn of long-term joint complications
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya cases in Bahia have reached 3,191 probable cases from January to mid-June 2026, marking a 92% increase compared to the same period in 2025, which had 1,662 cases. The outbreak spans 141 municipalities, including Salvador, where health officials caution about the potential for persistent joint pain following the acute phase of the illness. Dr. Viviane Machicado from Clínica IBIS highlights that chikungunya primarily affects joints, with 30-60% of patients experiencing ongoing arthralgia. A study over 36 months indicated that around 60% of individuals reported episodic joint pain. Symptoms to watch for include persistent pain, swelling, morning stiffness, and difficulty with movement. Those at higher risk for severe outcomes include older adults, women, and individuals with preexisting rheumatologic conditions. Treatment approaches are tailored to individual needs, often involving analgesics, anti-inflammatories, and physiotherapy, with specialized care available at Clínica IBIS.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのチクングニア熱：保健当局が長期的な関節合併症について警告
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱の既知の流行（バイア州での92%増加）が報告されているが、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクが明確でなく、情報が限定的。流行可能性は高いが管理可能性については不明。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。IHR基準では2つ以上該当し、WPRO基準でも4つ該当する高リスク指標を示しているが、対象地域外のため WATCHレベルの判定。記事はポルトガル語ソース（folhadonortejornal.com.br）からの英訳と考えられ、バイア州における明らかな流行進行中（141自治体、3,191症例、前年比92%増）が確認される。関節炎の長期後遺症リスク（60%が慢性疼痛報告）についての医学的警告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis in India: Rising cases and mortality challenge public health efforts
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis, commonly known as rat fever, has emerged as a significant public health concern in Kerala, India, with cases more than tripling over the past five years. From 2021 to 2025, the state recorded 1,455 deaths, resulting in a concerning mortality rate of 6%. As of June 23, 2026, Kerala has reported 1,531 new cases and 56 deaths this year alone. The 2018–2019 floods are identified as a key ecological factor contributing to the disease's resurgence, alongside a notable increase in cases post-lockdown in 2022, with annual figures surpassing 5,000. Despite the alarming statistics, public health initiatives have primarily focused on other diseases like dengue and shigellosis, leaving leptospirosis under-addressed. The infection is linked to rodent-borne leptospires in flood-prone areas, highlighting the need for increased awareness and intervention strategies to combat this growing threat.

triage.headline_ja: インド：レプトスピラ症の増加する事例と死亡率が公衆衛生対策に課題をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、管理可能性の懸念）。ケララ州での過去5年間での症例の3倍化と6%の死亡率は実質的な公衆衛生上の脅威を示唆。
triage.notes: ケララ州に集中しているが、全インドの公衆衛生課題として報道されている。2018-2019年の洪水が生態学的背景因子として特定されており、気候変動と関連した再発生のリスクがある。現在の公衆衛生対応がデング熱やシゲラ症に偏っており、レプトスピラ症への対策が不十分である点が管理可能性の懸念を高める。国際的な技術支援・疾病監視連携の必要性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Hemorrhagic Fever in Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola outbreak poses regional threat and challenges
article.articleSummary: The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has escalated rapidly, with over 1,000 confirmed cases and 267 deaths reported by June 22. The outbreak has extended into Uganda, where 20 cases and 2 deaths have been documented, including among health workers. Uganda's response is bolstered by previous outbreak experiences, focusing on isolation, contact tracing, and safe burial practices. The strain responsible for this outbreak is particularly severe, causing hemorrhagic fever and lacking an available vaccine. Concerns are mounting for South Sudan, with models predicting a 69.3% likelihood of at least one case within the next 12 weeks. Projections indicate a potential rise to 8,210 cases by September if transmission remains unchecked, with worst-case scenarios suggesting over 66,000 cases and 10,000 deaths if control measures are not maintained. Neighboring countries like Rwanda and Burundi also face risks, while France has reported an imported case from a clinician treating patients in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：エボラ集団発生が地域的脅威と課題をもたらす

article.articleHeadline: Unknown Illness in Vietnam
article.articleSummary: In Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, five out of twenty shrimp samples tested positive for Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei (EHP), indicating a concerning presence of this disease-causing parasite in the region. article.articleHeadline: Tuberculosis in Brazil: High-profile case highlights ongoing health crisis
article.articleSummary: As of June 26, 2026, Brazilian rapper Mauro Davi dos Santos Nepomuceno, known as Oruam, has been diagnosed with critical pulmonary tuberculosis in Rio de Janeiro. He presents with significant lung lesions, a persistent cough, and has lost approximately 5 kg in the past month, indicating severe health deterioration. However, Judge Tula Corrêa de Mello denied this request, citing Oruam's evasion of court appearances for over 130 days since the issuance of an arrest warrant related to attempted homicide charges against two civil police officers. The judge has mandated a medical evaluation to assess the extent of his illness and potential treatment options if he surrenders or is located.

article.articleHeadline: Scrub Typhus in China: Recent pediatric cases highlight ongoing health concerns
article.articleSummary: Six pediatric cases of scrub typhus were recently treated at Xiamen Municipal Maternal and Child Health Hospital in Fujian, China. The patients, aged 2 to 10 years, presented with symptoms including high fever (39–41°C), malaise, and rash, with a notable postauricular eschar indicating Orientia tsutsugamushi infection, confirmed through metagenomic DNA testing. Scrub typhus is transmitted by larval chiggers, often leading to severe illness affecting the liver, kidneys, or heart if untreated. Prevention measures emphasize outdoor protection, such as wearing long sleeves and using DEET-based repellents. Early detection and treatment are crucial for rapid recovery, underscoring the importance of awareness and preventive strategies in affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の恙虫病：最近の小児患者の事例が継続的な健康上の懸念を浮き彫りにしている

triage.notes: 記事は中国福建省厦門市における小児恙虫病6例の臨床的対応を述べており、国家レベルでの危機管理上の懸念は明示されていない。恙虫病は既知の風土病であり「異常」ではないと判断される。情報入手元がメディア記事であり、公開データベースの記載ではないため、政府当局の公式対応状況は不明。続報により国内での流行規模拡大または政府対応の強化が報告される場合はPICKUPへの昇格が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Varicella in Vietnam: Recent case highlights health risks for travelers
article.articleSummary: A 23-year-old Canadian tourist in Ho Chi Minh City developed shingles, a reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus, presenting with red spots and mild itching on his arm. Within 48 hours, the condition escalated to extensive cellulitis and acute lymphangitis, requiring hospitalization. Initially discharged for outpatient care, the rapid progression of the infection necessitated inpatient treatment due to the risk of sepsis. The case is notable as shingles typically affects older or immunocompromised individuals, making this occurrence in a healthy young adult unusual. Treatment involved antiviral therapy and intravenous antibiotics, leading to significant improvement and discharge after three days. This incident underscores potential health risks for travelers in Vietnam, particularly regarding varicella-related conditions.

triage.notes: 単一症例の報告であり、ベトナムにおける帯状疱疹の流行・多発を示唆していない。記事は旅行者向けのリスク啓発が主目的と思われる。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（異常性）。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性と重症度が該当するが、国家レベルの感染症イベントとしての根拠は弱い。政府レベルの関心の有無、正式な流行宣言の有無は記事から不明。

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever in Philippines: Containment efforts intensify amid rising pig mortality
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of African Swine Fever (ASF) in San Enrique, Negros Occidental, has led to the infection and death of over 500 pigs across 10 villages. Laboratory tests confirmed the presence of ASF, with a provincewide pig mortality rate of 4.06% as of Tuesday. In response, local authorities have implemented containment measures, including the burial of carcasses, farm disinfection, and enhanced biosecurity protocols. Executive orders from Moises Padilla and La Castellana have restricted the entry of live pigs and pork products from other areas while allowing the movement of hogs out of the affected regions. An ASF Task Force has been reorganized to ensure timely reporting of cases, with funding sourced from disaster relief funds. As the situation evolves, the focus remains on controlling the spread of the virus and protecting the local livestock industry.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンのアフリカ豚熱：豚の死亡数増加の中で封じ込め努力が強化
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ASF）の発生であり、公衆衛生への直接的な人間への脅威は不明。ただしフィリピンでの確認例で農業経済への影響あり。継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Rubella in Philippines: Vaccination campaign aims to improve coverage and awareness
article.articleSummary: In 2025, Western Visayas reported 444 cases of measles and rubella, with 6 confirmed rubella cases amid significant immunization gaps. The region's vaccination rates fell below the 95% herd-immunity target, attributed to vaccine hesitancy and low public awareness. Notably, Capiz experienced its first measles cases in three years, while Iloilo City and province saw an increase in cases. The Department of Health (DOH-6) is addressing these challenges with a Phase 3 Measles-Rubella Supplementary Immunization Activity (MR-SIA) scheduled from August 10 to 28, 2026, targeting 408,114 children aged 6 to 59 months. The campaign will provide MR vaccines and Vitamin A to improve coverage and curb disease transmission, with specific targets set for each locality in the region.

article.articleHeadline: Classical Swine Fever in Brazil: Emergency measures implemented to control viral spread
article.articleSummary: A state of emergency has been extended in Piauí, Brazil, due to a Classical Swine Fever (CSF) outbreak. The decree, published on June 24, 2026, aims to contain and eliminate the viral agent, preventing further transmission within the state. Currently, no additional cases have been reported, but the extension reflects ongoing efforts to mitigate the risk of CSF spreading to other regions.

article.articleHeadline: Sporotrichosis in Brazil: New treatment center opens for infected cats
article.articleSummary: Canoas, Rio Grande do Sul, has established the first Sporotrichosis Treatment Center, inaugurated on June 25, 2026, at Bem-Estar Animal. This facility is designed to diagnose, treat, and hospitalize stray cats suffering from sporotrichosis, currently housing 110 cats despite having 80 beds available. Local residents registered in Cadúnico can bring their pets for consultations and testing. The center operates weekdays from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, with a WhatsApp contact for inquiries. In 2025, Canoas reported approximately 800 sporotrichosis cases, largely attributed to the flooding in 2024. The disease, caused by Sporothrix fungi, primarily affects the skin but can also impact lymphatic vessels and internal organs in severe cases. Transmission occurs through contact with infected animals' lesions or secretions. The center plans to provide itraconazole for home treatment later this year to assist pet owners who cannot afford care. Emphasis is placed on indoor housing and proper care of lesions, with treatment durations ranging from 180 days to a year.

article.articleHeadline: Yellow Fever in Brazil: Vaccination efforts intensified amid rising cases
article.articleSummary: As of June 25, 2026, Mogi das Cruzes City Hall has intensified yellow fever vaccination efforts following an epidemiological alert in São Paulo state. Recent data indicates 66 human cases and 37 deaths (case-fatality rate of 56.1%) reported from July 2024 to June 2025, with 93.9% of patients unvaccinated. In the current 2025/2026 period, there have been ten autochthonous cases and six deaths, all among unvaccinated individuals. The local health authorities emphasize the importance of vaccination, especially for residents in risk areas such as rural zones and parks, urging those without documented vaccination to seek evaluation. The vaccine is available for free at municipal health units, and individuals who received a fractional dose in 2018 are advised to check if a standard-dose booster is necessary. The alert from GVE VIII highlights the ecological corridors in Alto Tietê, which are critical for the virus's circulation, necessitating increased preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの黄熱病：症例増加に伴い予防接種の取り組みを強化

triage.notes: 発生地域はBrazilと記載されているが、Brazilは対象国リスト（895949=Zambia, 1694008=Philippines, 1605651=Thailand, 2300660=Ghana, 203312=DRC, 3469034=Brazil, 1643084=Indonesia, 1814991=China, 1327865=Myanmar, 1562822=Vietnam, 1269750=India）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。ただし記事内容は高い公衆衛生的重要性を示しており、地域外イベントであっても国際的関心が高い可能性がある。PICKUP判定は記事の疾患重症度と流行特性に基づくもの。

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Meningitis in Brazil: Investigation launched after student death and hospitalization

In response to the situation, the city has suspended the Redenção Student Olympic Games (JOER) to minimize gatherings during the ongoing epidemiological investigation. As of 2026, Pará state has reported 81 notifications of meningococcal meningitis, prompting the State Health Department (Sespa) to coordinate with local health offices to monitor the situation and implement necessary public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎：学生の死亡と入院後に調査開始

article.articleHeadline: Leishmaniasis in Brazil: Challenges in diagnosis and treatment access
article.articleSummary: In Acre, Brazil, leishmaniasis cutaneous is facing significant challenges due to delayed diagnosis stemming from a lack of awareness among both patients and health workers. A recent study conducted by UFAC involving 50 patients and 51 health agents revealed that 63% of the health workers were community health workers, highlighting a gap in knowledge regarding the disease. This has resulted in barriers to timely diagnosis and treatment, particularly in rural endemic areas. The North region of Brazil accounts for over half of the country's leishmaniasis cases, with Acre alone reporting more than 11,000 cases over the past decade. Areas such as Xapuri, Marechal Thaumaturgo, Assis Brasil, Sena Madureira, and Brasileia have been identified as high-risk zones for intense transmission as of 2025. The findings underscore the urgent need for targeted educational programs and improved access to healthcare services to address these critical gaps.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるリーシュマニア症：診断および治療アクセスの課題
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アクレ州における皮膚リーシュマニア症の診断遅延と治療アクセスの課題が報告されており、診断・管理可能性の面で懸念がある。しかし記事は主に既知の流行地域における構造的問題（啓発不足、医療従事者の知識ギャップ）を指摘しており、新規感染症の出現や大規模な発生拡大を示す明確な証拠がない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に含める。記事は既知の流行地域（アクレ州）における診断遅延と医療アクセスの構造的問題を扱っており、新規感染症イベントではない。しかし過去10年で11,000例以上が報告されている地域的に重要な疾患であり、診断・治療アクセスの改善の必要性が強調されている点から、継続的な経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Philippines: Insurance initiatives support families amid health challenges
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in the Philippines surpassed 15,000 during July and August 2025, coinciding with the back-to-school season. The Department of Health's data highlights the financial strain on families due to medical expenses and lost school days. In response, Pioneer Insurance is promoting its MediCash Dengue Insurance, which offers 12 months of coverage with a P10,000 cash benefit upon diagnosis, available for P350 per year per person. This insurance is designed for individuals aged 14 days to 70 years and can be claimed without hospitalization, complementing existing PhilHealth and HMOs. Additionally, Pioneer offers other insurance products like Ooopsie! Personal Accident Insurance and MediCash Leptospirosis to address various risks associated with school activities and daily commutes. The initiative aims to alleviate the burden of dengue-related costs, allowing families to prioritize health and recovery.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンのデング熱：保険イニシアティブが健康課題の中で家族をサポート
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンでデング熱の症例数が2025年7月～8月に15,000例を超えており、公衆衛生への影響がある。ただし記事は保険商品の宣伝が主体であり、疫学的詳細（死亡数、重症度、国際拡大リスク）が不明。続報での流行動向確認が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで周期的に流行する疾患であり、本記事は2025年7月～8月の15,000例超の発生報告を記述している。ただし記事の主体は保険商品の推促であり、疫学的な重症度データ（死亡数、入院数）が欠落。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（学期中の継続的な感染リスク）と「流行しやすさ」（既知のヒト-ヒト感染媒介蚊）で該当するが、公衆衛生当局からの正式アラートやWHO通知の兆候は記事からは不明。継続監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Campylobacteriosis in Brazil: Food safety measures critical to prevent infections
article.articleSummary: As of June 2026, Campylobacteriosis remains a significant public health concern in Brazil, primarily linked to contaminated food sources. The disease is often associated with undercooked poultry, unpasteurized dairy products, and cross-contamination in food preparation. Recent statistics indicate a notable number of cases, particularly among vulnerable populations such as children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals. Symptoms typically include diarrhea, abdominal pain, and fever, with severe cases potentially leading to hospitalization. The risk of outbreaks increases during festive seasons when large meals are prepared, highlighting the importance of food safety practices. Effective prevention strategies include thorough cooking of meats, proper washing of fruits and vegetables, and maintaining hygiene in food handling. Public health initiatives are focusing on raising awareness about these preventive measures to reduce the incidence of Campylobacteriosis and other foodborne illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのカンピロバクター症：感染症の予防に食品安全対策が重要
triage.triage_reason: カンピロバクター症は既知の食中毒疾患であり、ブラジルでの発生は常在的である。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の該当が限定的で、国際的拡大やPHEICレベルの懸念は示唆されていない。ただし脆弱集団への影響と食品安全警告の継続的な関心から経過観察が適切である。
triage.notes: カンピロバクター症は一般的な食中毒であり、ブラジルでの発生は周期的・地域的である。記事は既知の予防策と公衆衛生キャンペーンに焦点を当てており、新規の異常な拡大や国際的リスクの明確な証拠がない。重症度と脆弱集団への影響があるため完全なDISMISSではなく経過観察対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Indonesia: Community efforts crucial for ongoing prevention measures
article.articleSummary: As of mid-2026, Sleman Regency in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, reports a total of 76 dengue cases with no fatalities. This marks a significant decline from previous years, with 675 cases in 2024 and 423 in 2025. The decrease is largely attributed to effective Wolbachia mosquito release programs and active community-led mosquito control initiatives. Health officials emphasize the importance of continued vigilance, urging local residents to engage in preventive measures through community health groups and environmental sanitation efforts. Despite the absence of local transmission and outbreaks, officials stress that maintaining these preventive strategies is vital to avoid any resurgence of dengue cases.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのデング熱：継続的な予防策における地域の取り組みが重要
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（対象国）でのデング熱発生は確認されるが、症例数は大幅に減少しており、死亡者がなく、流行はコントロール下にある。IHR基準やWPRO基準の明確な該当が限定的であるため、今後の推移を注視する段階と判定。
triage.notes: デング熱は流行しやすい疾患であり、蚊媒介による継続的な曝露リスクが存在するため、WPRO基準で2つ該当。一方、症例数が顕著に減少（2024年675例→2026年76例）、死亡者なし、当局による予防策（Wolbachia蚊放出、地域の蚊制御）が奏功している点から、深刻な影響は現在のところなし。インドネシアは対象国のため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in Brazil: Ongoing challenges in controlling vector-borne diseases
article.articleSummary: As of June 2026, Brazil is facing significant challenges with malaria, particularly in the context of recent travel-related cases. A confirmed malaria case has been reported in Rio de Janeiro involving a patient who traveled to Uganda. This highlights the ongoing risk of vector-borne diseases in the region, especially as health authorities remain vigilant due to the potential for co-infections with other diseases like Ebola. In São Paulo, a suspected Ebola case is under investigation, further complicating the public health landscape. The Brazilian health system is on high alert, emphasizing the need for comprehensive testing and monitoring of travelers returning from endemic areas. The situation underscores the importance of continued efforts in vector control and public health education to mitigate the impact of malaria and other infectious diseases.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのマラリア：媒介動物感染症の制御における継続的な課題
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルはトリアージ対象国外のため、該当する verified_locations がなく PICKUP 判定には至らないが、マラリア確認症例と疑い例の報告、複数地域での発生、国際的な懸念事項（ウガンダからの移入例、エボラの懸念）が存在するため、情報継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは CEPRのトリアージ対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locations は空配列。ただし、記事は IHR基準を2つ満たし（異常性と国際的拡大リスク）、複数のスクリーニング基準を満たすシグナル指標を含むが、対象国外のため PICKUP ではなく WATCH 判定。続報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Brazil: Investigation of suspected cases raises health concerns
article.articleSummary: As of June 25, 2026, Brazil is investigating two suspected cases of Ebola. In São Paulo, a man who recently returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo is in severe condition, requiring intubation and exhibiting symptoms of meningitis. Meanwhile, a patient in Rio de Janeiro, who traveled to Uganda, has been confirmed with malaria, but health authorities emphasize that this does not eliminate the possibility of Ebola. The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is escalating, with confirmed cases now at 282, including 19 new infections, primarily in the Ituri region. The situation remains critical as Ebola is highly transmissible through bodily fluids, prompting health systems in Brazil and Europe to remain vigilant. Authorities are conducting broad differential testing to ensure accurate diagnoses and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのエボラ：疑いのある症例の調査が健康懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラの疑い症例がブラジルで検出され、DRCでの流行が拡大中（282例、死亡数不明）。国際的な懸念と健康システムの警戒態勢から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC由来のエボラが疑われるブラジルへの輸入症例を報告。DRC自体は対象国リストに含まれるため（203312=DRC）、DRCでの流行状況も関連するが、本記事の主題はブラジルでの調査であり verified_locations は Brazil のみとした。ブラジルはWPRO地域外（南米）だが、IHRおよび国際的な重要性からシグナルとして識別。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis in Indonesia: Rising cases and fatalities prompt urgent health response
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in Pati Regency, Indonesia, have surged significantly, with the Pati District Health Office reporting an increase from 7 cases in 2022 to 22 in 2023, escalating to 172 cases by May 2026. The disease, caused by bacteria from rat urine, has resulted in 17 deaths by 2025 and 21 fatalities in 2026. High-risk populations, including farmers and fishermen, are particularly vulnerable due to their exposure to contaminated water and soil. Symptoms include fever, nausea, and distinctive calf muscle pain, with severe cases leading to kidney complications. Recent reports indicate a suspected case linked to contaminated beverages. In response, health outreach efforts are being intensified across affected areas to mitigate further transmission and prevent additional fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのレプトスピラ症：増加する患者数と死亡例が緊急の保健対応を促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常な上昇傾向・国際拡散リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、死亡例の増加と農民・漁業者等の広範な曝露により管理可能性に懸念あり。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: パティ県での患者数が2022年の7件から2026年5月で172件へと急増、死亡例も2025年17名から2026年21名へと増加。農民・漁業者など特定の職業グループが高リスク。飲料汚染による感染疑い事例も報告。地域保健機関が対応強化中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in India: Enhanced airport protocols for traveler health monitoring
article.articleSummary: The recent Ebola virus outbreak has led to the launch of the upgraded Air Suvidha 2.0 portal in India, aimed at bolstering surveillance at airports. This initiative, introduced by the Civil Aviation Ministry and Delhi International Airport Limited, allows international travelers to submit their health information online prior to immigration clearance. The self-declaration form captures essential details, including a 21-day travel history, medical illness history, and any symptoms. This digital approach facilitates real-time data sharing with airport health officers and state surveillance officials, enabling swift identification of at-risk travelers and ensuring they receive necessary care. The portal eliminates the need for paper forms upon arrival, streamlining the process for travelers who can complete the declaration 24 hours before their flight and present it upon landing.

triage.headline_ja: インドでのエボラ出血熱：空港での搭乗者健康監視に向けた強化措置
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高致死性・高影響力疾患が対象国インドで報告されているが、記事サマリーは監視体制強化の施策紹介に終始しており、実際の患者発生状況、重症度、国内伝播の詳細が全く記載されていない。情報不足のため慎重な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは空港監視システム（Air Suvidha 2.0）の導入という行政対応に焦点を当てており、実際のエボラウイルス患者の発生状況、確認患者数、死亡者数、国内・国際的な伝播リスク、患者発生の地理的分布などの具体的な疫学情報が完全に欠落している。『recent Ebola virus outbreak』と言及されているが、いつ、どこで、何例の患者が発生しているのか不明。フルRRAに進む前に、実際の患者発生情報の確認と詳細なニュースソースの取得が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Vietnam: Recent fatalities highlight ongoing public health challenges
article.articleSummary: In Vietnam, rabies continues to pose a significant public health threat, as evidenced by recent fatalities. A 56-year-old man in Gia Lai Province died on June 20 after being bitten by a stray dog, despite receiving rabies immunoglobulin and completing a vaccination regimen. He developed severe symptoms, including hydrophobia, after initially being treated locally. Investigations revealed that many nearby households kept unvaccinated, free-roaming dogs, increasing the risk of rabies transmission. Additionally, a separate case in Dak Lak Province involved a 13-year-old boy who also succumbed to rabies after failing to receive post-exposure vaccination following dog bites. In response to these incidents, health authorities are intensifying efforts to vaccinate pets, promote responsible pet ownership, and encourage immediate medical consultation for bite victims.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの狂犬病：最近の死亡者が継続的な公衆衛生上の課題を浮き彫りにしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。複数の死亡例と動物媒介感染症であり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数満たす。狂犬病は管理可能な予防可能疾患であるが、ワクチン接種後の死亡報告はリスク信号。
triage.notes: ワクチン接種完了後の死亡例（56歳男性）は異常であり、注目に値する。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれており、Gia Lai Province及びDak Lak Provinceでの発生が確認されている。記事は複数の死亡例と継続的な公衆衛生の課題を報告しており、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Human Metapneumovirus Infection in Brazil: Winter season exacerbates respiratory illness cases
article.articleSummary: As of June 23, 2026, Londrina, Brazil, has reported two new deaths attributed to respiratory viruses, increasing the total fatalities to 24 for the year. The active circulation of various viruses, including Influenza A and B, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), Rhinovirus, Adenovirus, and Metapneumovirus, has intensified Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) cases. Hospitalizations for adult SARI have surged from 31 to 53 within a week, while pediatric admissions have slightly decreased from 18 to 13. The Pediatric Emergency Department recorded 2,808 visits, with 904 (32.19%) related to flu-like symptoms. In adult urgent care centers, there were 16,116 visits, with 2,316 (14.37%) for similar symptoms. The breakdown of deaths includes 15 unspecified, 5 from influenza, and 4 from RSV. Vaccination rates remain concerningly low, with overall coverage at 52.91%, prompting health authorities to emphasize vaccination as a critical preventive measure during the winter months.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるヒトメタニューモウイルス感染症：冬季が呼吸器疾患症例を悪化させている
triage.triage_reason: 冬季に複数の呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザ、RSV、メタニューモウイルス等）の循環により、SARI症例と死亡が報告されている。ただし、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれ、重症度と異常性は認められるものの、WPROスクリーニング基準では1つ該当（重症度）で、国際的拡大リスクや管理可能性に関する情報が不足しているため、追加情報の収集を優先する。
triage.notes: 記事の発生地域にはBrazil（3469034）が含まれているが、Brazilは対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に明示されている。ただし、検索結果から記事本文は提供されておらず、サマリーのみの評価となっている。Brazilは対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsにBrazilを追加する必要があります。訂正：Brazilは対象国リスト内に含まれているため、verified_locationsはBrazil（3469034）を含めるべきです。ここでWATCH判定としたのは、IHR基準で2つ以上該当しているため本来はPICKUP候補ですが、対象国リストとの照合で精査が必要なためです。

article.articleHeadline: HIV in India: Investigation launched over HIV cases in thalassemia patients
article.articleSummary: In Satna, India, a case of HIV infection among thalassemia patients has led to a departmental inquiry against Chief Medical Health Officer (CMHO) Dr. Manoj Shukla. The Directorate of Public Health and Medical Education issued a charge sheet citing serious irregularities at the district Blood Bank during Shukla's tenure. Key issues include failure to maintain donor records, lack of logging for HIV-testing kit details, and non-compliance with pre-transfusion HIV screening protocols. The report highlights inadequate inspections and weak controls over illicit blood donations, raising concerns about the safety of blood center operations. The National Human Rights Commission has recommended disciplinary action following the discovery of five HIV-positive thalassemia patients in October 2025. Currently, three employees, including the Blood Bank in-charge and two lab technicians, are suspended pending further investigation.

triage.headline_ja: インド：サラ地区の地中海貧血患者におけるHIV感染事例に関する調査開始
triage.triage_reason: 医療施設における複数のHIV感染者発生（5例以上確認）、血液安全管理の重大な不備（screening protocol違反、donor record未維持等）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、医療関連感染の対象となる異常・予想外な事象である。
triage.notes: 医療施設関連感染（healthcare-associated transmission）。2025年10月に5例のHIV陽性地中海貧血患者が発見されたと記載。血液銀行での重大な運営不備（HIV検査キットのログ欠落、提供者記録の未維持、screening protocol違反）が原因として特定されている。国家人権委員会が懲罰的措置を勧告。すでに3名の職員が職務停止中。

article.articleHeadline: Scrub Typhus in Vietnam: Recent cases highlight critical health challenges
article.articleSummary: In Vietnam, scrub typhus continues to pose significant health risks, with recent cases illustrating severe outcomes. A 49-year-old woman from Thanh Hóa experienced multi-organ failure due to the disease, requiring intensive medical intervention, including mechanical ventilation. She presented with symptoms such as persistent fever and dyspnea, alongside an eschar from a chigger bite. Other notable cases include a 70-year-old man with a confirmed infection and a 66-year-old woman diagnosed with meningitis/encephalitis linked to scrub typhus. The disease, caused by Orientia tsutsugamushi, is transmitted through chigger larvae and is prevalent in Vietnam, particularly during the seasonal peaks from May to October in the north and year-round in the south. With no available vaccine, prevention strategies focus on environmental hygiene and protective clothing to mitigate transmission risks.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのツツガムシ病：最近の症例が重大な健康課題を浮き彫りに
triage.triage_reason: ツツガムシ病によるベトナムでの重症例（多臓器不全、髄膜炎/脳炎）が報告されており、IHR基準で異常性・重症度が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準で重症度・流行リスク・季節性が該当する。シグナルとして識別し、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムのツツガムシ病症例を中心に、複数の重症事例（多臓器不全、髄膜炎/脳炎）を報告している。Phu Tho省およびThanh Hóa省での発症が具体的に記載されている。季節性のパターン（北部は5月～10月、南部は通年）が示され、流行リスクが高い。ワクチンがないため、ベトナムの感染症管理能力に関する情報がある程度必要。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A in India: Bengaluru toddler battles severe respiratory complications
article.articleSummary: In March 2026, a 20-month-old boy in Bengaluru was hospitalized with severe Influenza A, leading to acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), air-leak syndrome, and cardiogenic shock. The child exhibited symptoms such as high fever, persistent illness, and worsening breathlessness, prompting immediate medical intervention. Despite the challenges, including suspected hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) and acute liver injury, the child underwent advanced treatments including high-flow nasal cannula (HFNC), conventional ventilation, and ultimately, veno-arterial (VA) and veno-venous (VV) extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) over a six-week period. Following intensive care, the toddler was discharged in stable condition. This incident highlights the ongoing threat of Influenza A in Bengaluru, particularly following a previous outbreak in December 2025. Health authorities recommend annual flu vaccinations for children over six months to mitigate risks associated with severe influenza infections.

triage.headline_ja: インドのインフルエンザA：ベンガルール幼児が重度の呼吸器合併症と闘う
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザAによる個別の重症小児症例報告であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度）に該当するが、地域流行の規模や全国的な医療体制への影響が明確でないため、情報確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は1症例の重症小児インフルエンザA感染を詳細に報告しており、重症度基準（ARDS、ECMO要否）を満たしている。ただし、同年12月の前回アウトブレイク言及があるも、現在の流行規模、患者数、死亡例の有無などが不明。フルRRA前に、ベンガルール/カルナタカ州における現在の流行状況（患者数、死亡数、医療逼迫度）の情報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hand Foot And Mouth Disease in China: Recent outbreaks prompt urgent health measures
article.articleSummary: Guangdong province is experiencing a significant outbreak of hand-foot-and-mouth disease (HFMD), with approximately 28,000 cases reported in the last month. Concurrently, Hong Kong has recorded 60 cases, indicating rising activity in the region. The Hong Kong Department of Health highlights that HFMD typically peaks during the months of May to July and October to December, particularly affecting children. Parents are urged to enforce strict hygiene practices, such as ensuring children wash their hands with soap for at least 20 seconds after using playground equipment. Severe symptoms that necessitate immediate medical attention include persistent sleep disturbances, convulsions, lethargy, irritability, frequent vomiting, and involuntary limb movements. An inactivated EV71 vaccine is available for children aged 6 months to 5 years, with two doses recommended before the age of 12 months. While the vaccine protects against severe HFMD associated with EV71, it does not cover other strains like Coxsackie, underscoring the importance of continued hygiene measures.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の手足口病: 最近の流行が緊急の保健対策を促す

article.articleHeadline: Japanese Encephalitis in Vietnam: Rising cases and severe outcomes reported nationwide
article.articleSummary: Japanese encephalitis (JE) cases in Vietnam are increasing, particularly in Nghệ An, Hanoi, and Ho Chi Minh City. Recent reports highlight severe cases, including a 2011-born child who developed encephalitis and pneumonia, requiring mechanical ventilation, and a 17-year-old who suffered significant brain injury after prolonged treatment. A 13-year-old in Hanoi is facing a guarded prognosis, while three young men in Ho Chi Minh City experienced serious outcomes, including quadriplegia. The disease, transmitted by Culex mosquitoes in rural areas, has seen 617 suspected encephalitis cases in Vietnam, with JE confirmed in 33% of these, leading to a 16% fatality rate and approximately 49% of survivors facing neurological complications. Although vaccination can reduce annual cases to 100-200, lapses in booster doses remain a concern. The vaccination schedule includes three primary doses followed by boosters every 3-4 years, as there is currently no antiviral treatment available.

article.articleHeadline: Pneumococcus in Vietnam: Urgent call for vaccination and prevention strategies
article.articleSummary: In Vietnam, invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD) has led to alarming child fatality rates, prompting a critical shift from treatment to prevention. Recent data indicates that pneumococcus is responsible for 86.1% of bacterial meningitis cases in children under five in southern Vietnam from 2012 to 2021. A study conducted in Hanoi from 2019 to 2022 revealed an 8.8% case-fatality rate among hospitalized pediatric IPD patients. Serotype 19F, prevalent in 17% of asymptomatic children, is linked to 25% of confirmed IPD deaths at the National Children’s Hospital. Resistance to third-generation cephalosporins is noted in 75.3% of IPD strains, with nearly universal resistance to erythromycin and clindamycin. Approximately one-third of Vietnamese children are asymptomatic carriers, with those aged 2-18 years and suffering from chronic illnesses at higher risk. The Vietnam Association of Preventive Medicine, in collaboration with Pfizer Việt Nam, is advocating for early vaccination as part of the Ministry of Health's 2026-28 immunization program to combat this public health crisis.

article.articleSummary: In 2026, Hanoi is implementing proactive strategies to combat dengue fever as the humid season approaches. Year-to-date statistics show 418 cases in 94 communes, a significant rise from 297 cases during the same period in 2025, with no reported deaths. The city has experienced 10 outbreaks this year, four of which are currently active. Authorities are focusing on a 'prevention first' approach, which includes environmental cleaning, larval control, vector surveillance, and community education to facilitate early detection and rapid response. article.articleHeadline: Lyme in China: Fatal case highlights tick-borne infection risks
article.articleSummary: A 56-year-old man from Jixi, Heilongjiang, died on June 17 after being bitten by a tick, locally referred to as a 'grass crawler.' He experienced severe symptoms, including high fever and altered consciousness, starting June 8. Initially undiagnosed, he was admitted to Jixi People’s Hospital on June 9 and later transferred to the ICU at Harbin Medical University First Hospital on June 10, where he was diagnosed with tick-borne encephalitis virus infection and Lyme disease. Despite receiving intravenous immunoglobulin and supportive care, he succumbed to the illness after a week in the hospital. This incident underscores the risks associated with tick exposure during outdoor activities in Heilongjiang, although no ongoing outbreak has been reported, indicating this is a singular fatal case.
